payload._note: Select Medical Holdings operates 107 critical illness recovery hospitals (LTCHs) in 28 states, 33 rehabilitation hospitals (IRFs) in 13 states, 1,933 outpatient rehabilitation clinics in 39 states and DC, 544 Concentra occupational health centers in 41 states, and 150 onsite clinics at employer worksites as of December 31, 2023. The 10-K provides state-level facility counts in Item 2 Properties table (pages 50-51) but does not disclose individual facility names, addresses, cities, or Medicare CCNs except for two facilities mentioned in legal proceedings: Select Specialty Hospital Oklahoma City (OK) and Select Specialty Hospital Wichita (KS). Without facility-level disclosure of names and CCNs in this filing, only these two facilities mentioned in litigation can be extracted with certainty. The state-level counts show facilities across 46 states plus DC, with major concentrations in Pennsylvania (267 total facilities), Texas (213), Florida (172), New Jersey (201), and Ohio (147). The filing does not contain schedules or exhibits listing individual facility CCNs or detailed facility rosters that would enable CCN extraction for the full portfolio.
